description: Migration creates opportunity_evidence_citations (tenant, citation_id, evidence_id, ref_type, ref_id, position, created_at) with PK (tenant, citation_id), unique (tenant, evidence_id, ref_type, ref_id), index (tenant, evidence_id) and a CHECK limiting ref_type to interaction or document

The citations table is distributed on tenant and colocated with tenants on Citus before its foreign key (tenant, evidence_id) to opportunity_evidence is added; the migration is a no-op for distribution on plain Postgres
Idempotent backfill copies every user_declared evidence row's interaction or document ref into a citation at position 0 and nulls ref_type and ref_id on that row, for active and corrected rows
Idempotent data migration sets detail to NULL on user_declared rows whose detail is exactly 'Stage manually set to <checkpoint>'
opportunity_evidence_citations is registered in the tenant table manifest, metadata and foreign-key lists and is deleted before opportunity_evidence in tenant deletion
The engine has a single internal writer for user declarations that resolves note and citations against the live declaration with patch semantics (undefined keeps, null or empty clears)
Writing a declaration whose resolved content equals the live declaration's content performs no write
Writing changed content corrects the live declaration with the supersede note and inserts a replacement row with its citation rows in order
A replacement declaration inherits recorded_at and recorded_by from the row it supersedes; the editor and time are on the superseded row's corrected_by and corrected_at
Every citation on a declaration is checked by assertRefBelongsToOpportunity; a foreign, cross-tenant, unattached or unsupported source refuses the whole write
A declaration accepts at most 25 citations and stores each (type, id) once
declareStage takes declaration content (note and citations) in place of detail and ref, and no longer writes the 'Stage manually set to' placeholder note
declareStage called with no content on a checkpoint that has a live declaration leaves that declaration's note and citations untouched

amendDeclaration replaces the note and citations of the declaration for a reached checkpoint without correcting other evidence, without changing the opportunity's stage and without publishing OPPORTUNITY_STAGE_CHANGED
amendDeclaration refuses a checkpoint that has no active evidence with a typed error, and refuses the won checkpoint
amendDeclaration on a checkpoint reached only by system evidence inserts the first user_declared row beside it, recorded now by the editor
amendDeclaration works on won and lost opportunities for the qualified, assessment, proposed and verbal checkpoints
Completing a step tied to a checkpoint that already has a live declaration leaves the declaration alone; with none, it seeds a declaration whose note is the step title
The opportunity detail ladder exposes each rung's declaration with evidence id, note, recorded_at and its citations (type, id, label, missing) in position order
A citation whose interaction is deleted or belongs to another opportunity, or whose document is no longer attached to the deal, resolves as missing with a null label and never errors
declareOpportunityStage server action accepts declaration content and requires opportunity update permission
amendOpportunityDeclaration server action requires opportunity update permission and maps the engine's source refusal to 'That source is not attached to this opportunity'
The declaration dialog has an optional note text area and a supporting-sources list with add (searchable, grouped Interactions and Documents, labelled by title or name and date) and remove
The dialog opens to declare a stage ('Move to {stage}', Declare) and to edit a reached stage's declaration ('Evidence for {stage}', Save) with the note and sources prefilled
A failed source lookup leaves the note and submit usable, and a prefilled source whose target is gone shows as 'Source removed' and can be removed
Each reached rung from Qualified to Verbal shows the declaration's note and every source as a link; a missing source shows the muted 'Source removed' badge

Each reached rung from Qualified to Verbal has an Edit evidence control (Add evidence when there is no declaration), including the current stage and on closed deals, shown only when the host supplies the handler
Saving from the edit dialog calls the amend action, refreshes the deal and leaves the stage unchanged; declaring from a rung circle passes the note and sources to the declare action
Clicking a source link opens the interaction in the interaction drawer or the document in the document viewer, on the full opportunity page and in the client-page opportunity drawer
The documents cross-feature context exposes getDocument, and the cited-document viewer fetches the one cited document through it instead of a page of the deal's document list
New dialog and rung strings exist in every msp/opportunities locale file including the pseudo-locales

POST /api/v1/opportunities/{id}/evidence and POST /api/v1/opportunities/{id}/stage accept citations beside detail; refType and refId remain accepted as a single citation and are rejected with 400 when sent together with citations
PUT /api/v1/opportunities/{id}/declarations/{checkpoint} amends the declaration with patch semantics, returns the opportunity, and answers 409 for an unreached checkpoint
GET /api/v1/opportunities/{id}/evidence returns each row's citations
OpenAPI route definitions, the generated OpenAPI documents and the generated MCP and chat API registries include the new endpoint and fields
The follow-up drafting prompt prints a fallback instead of null for a declaration with no note
